description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.detect parity: constants, sniff arbitration, thresholds, to_source_block, explicit resolve, and documented finding fingerprint gaps.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-detect-finding-fingerprint: resolve_format and resolve_format_bytes call _resolve_failure_finding when detection abstains. The pin builds a Finding via make_finding without fingerprint. Rust stops at sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes and does not return a Finding.
GAP-detect-cli: test_detect.py CLI smoke tests invoke sesslint.cli.main, which is outside this adapters.detect parity surface.
GAP-detect-mock-scores: boundary and effective-threshold tests patch per-adapter detect_* callables. Vectors use real sniff bytes instead.
